0022600117.text: The Pistons (2-0, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, on a two-game winning streak) visit the 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 3rd in the East, also on a two-game streak) for Detroit's third game of the 2026-27 season. Ausar Thompson (undisclosed) and Jalen Duren (thigh) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions for the Pistons, while Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture) and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and Detroit won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 116-93 win in Philadelphia on April 4, 2026.
